violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the employee restroom was lacking paper towels. Extra paper towels on hand for replacement at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2026

The 2nd door from the left to the customer side of the walk-in cooler were observed not shutting properly leaving a gap between the door and the frame of the door. Equipment is to be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026

The wall behind the 3 bay sink and hand sink along with the structure the hand sink is installed on are constructed of wood. This material is not smooth, durable, non-absorbent, and easily cleanable. Materials for wall surfaces and other structures shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. New Violation. Correct By: 11/30/2026

The following was observed to be in need of repair/adjustment... - The 2 far left doors to the customer side of the walk-in cooler were observed not shutting properly leaving a gap between the door and the frame of the door. - The sealed ceiling surface in the walk-in cooler was observed to be worn/thin and in need of resealing. New Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2025

The outdoor areas were observed to have a buildup of debris/old equipment. Outdoor areas are to be maintained to prevent harborage conditions for rodents and other pests. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2025
